fea.title: turn
fea.assumptions: Linear elastic, small deflection, isotropic: printed parts use the weak (layer) direction strength. Every field scales with the load. It shows where and at what load the part first reaches its strength, not how a crack grows after that. Faces clamped where held; no contact, preload or buckling. Elements touching the clamp and load patches are left out of the failure test and capped at the design stress (their spikes are artefacts of the idealised supports). Stresses are element corner peaks, as the safety factor uses; the overstressed volume counts whole elements (an upper bound). The section cut shows the surface skin, not the stress inside.

clearance.limits: sampled poses only (not a swept volume); exact gaps by cadagent.review.gates.relations.relate, per pair of solids; a pair touching at every pose is a designed contact and has no gap to state; a pair apart at every pose by a gap that varies by at most 0.02 mm is a running gap about a shared axis; the rest pass each other

tagline.text: Tells an AI agent whether its design is right.
